resources.string: CRXCIBL3 uses Bluetooth to discover nearby co-op sessions. No contacts or audio are accessed.
Bluetooth scan finds crew members playing nearby for local co-op matchmaking.
Bluetooth connect links your device to a host for offline co-op play.
Bluetooth advertise lets friends discover your co-op session on the same network.
Android requires location permission to scan for nearby Bluetooth devices during co-op discovery. Your GPS position is never stored.
Network access enables Wi-Fi and mobile co-op session discovery.
Network state lets CRXCIBL3 choose the best transport for co-op (Wi-Fi vs mobile).
